metadata.name: stale-revision-conflict
metadata.description: Open a synthetic UI event, commit a concurrent supported API revision, then prove the stale ordinary UI save reports conflict and preserves newer durable content.

evaluate.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid="calendar-event-title"]'); if (!el) throw new Error('event title input missing'); const title = 'E1 D2 stale synthetic ' + crypto.randomUUID(); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(el, title); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true})); window.__e1D2StaleTitle = title; return title; })()

metadata.label: Make this run's synthetic fixture identity unique

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const message = () => document.querySelector('[data-testid="calendar-event-message"]')?.textContent || ''; const savedID = (text) => { const match = text.match(/event ([^,]+), revision 1/); return match && match[1]; }; let text = message(); if (text.includes('The save outcome could not be confirmed')) { const check = document.querySelector('[data-testid="calendar-event-check-status"]'); if (!check) throw new Error('uncertain create did not offer idempotency status lookup'); check.click(); const deadline = Date.now() + 15000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50)); text = message(); if (text.includes('The earlier save succeeded:') || text.includes('No event exists for this key yet') || text.includes('Event status is still unavailable')) break; } if (text.includes('The earlier save succeeded:')) { const id = savedID(text); if (!id) throw new Error('status recovery omitted durable event ID'); window.__e1D2StaleEventID = id; } else if (text.includes('No event exists for this key yet')) { const retry = document.querySelector('[data-testid="calendar-event-create"]'); if (!retry || retry.textContent?.trim() !== 'Retry same event') throw new Error('confirmed absent event did not offer same-key retry'); retry.click(); const retryDeadline = Date.now() + 15000; while (Date.now() < retryDeadline) { await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50)); text = message(); if (text.includes(' as event ') || text.includes('The save outcome could not be confirmed')) break; } const id = savedID(text); if (!id) throw new Error('same-key retry did not confirm a durable event ID'); window.__e1D2StaleEventID = id; } else { throw new Error('idempotency status remained unknown; preserving the unresolved save'); } } else { const id = savedID(text); if (!id) throw new Error('create did not confirm a durable revision-1 event'); window.__e1D2StaleEventID = id; } return JSON.stringify({id:window.__e1D2StaleEventID, message:text}); })()

metadata.label: Resolve uncertain create by key before any same-key retry

evaluate.expression: (() => { const card = document.querySelector('[data-event-title="' + CSS.escape(window.__e1D2StaleTitle) + '"]'); if (!card) throw new Error('newly created synthetic event not visible'); card.click(); return 'opened current-run synthetic event'; })()

metadata.label: Reopen current-run revision 1 in ordinary UI

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const title = window.__e1D2StaleTitle; const card = document.querySelector('[data-event-title="' + CSS.escape(title) + '"]'); const label = card && card.getAttribute('aria-label') || ''; const m = label.match(/event ([^,]+)/); const heading = document.querySelector('[data-testid="calendar-event-revision"]')?.textContent || ''; if (!m || !heading.includes('EVENT REVISION 1')) throw new Error('expected reopened current-run event revision 1: ' + heading + ' ' + label); const id = m[1].trim(); window.__e1D2StaleEventID = id; const get = await fetch('/api/v1/calendar/events/' + encodeURIComponent(id)); if (!get.ok) throw new Error('API seed read failed: ' + get.status); const e = await get.json(); const body = {...e, title: 'E1 D2 concurrent API winner', expected_revision: e.revision}; delete body.id; delete body.revision; delete body.created_at; delete body.updated_at; const put = await fetch('/api/v1/calendar/events/' + encodeURIComponent(id), {method:'PUT', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body:JSON.stringify(body)}); if (put.status !== 200) throw new Error('concurrent supported API update failed: ' + put.status + ' ' + await put.text()); const saved = await put.json(); if (saved.revision !== 2 || saved.title !== 'E1 D2 concurrent API winner') throw new Error('concurrent API update did not commit expected revision 2'); return JSON.stringify({id, revision:saved.revision, title:saved.title}); })()

assert.failure_message: Ordinary UI should report the stale expected-revision conflict

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const id = window.__e1D2StaleEventID; if (!id) throw new Error('current-run event ID missing after conflict'); const r = await fetch('/api/v1/calendar/events/' + encodeURIComponent(id)); if (!r.ok) throw new Error('independent durable API readback failed: ' + r.status); const e = await r.json(); if (e.id !== id || e.revision !== 2 || e.title !== 'E1 D2 concurrent API winner') throw new Error('stale UI save overwrote or lost concurrent durable revision'); return JSON.stringify({id:e.id, revision:e.revision, title:e.title}); })()

metadata.label: Independent readback proves newer durable content remains
